_readme: order sets the sequence on every screen. The as-of date lives in meta.json. See docs/DATA_MODEL.md.

uls.name: UL Solutions Inc.
uls.description: Safety science company: product testing, inspection and certification, with compliance software. Listed on the NYSE in April 2024. Reports three segments from 2026: Industrial, Consumer, and Risk & Compliance Software.

sgs.name: SGS SA
sgs.description: Testing, inspection and certification across industrial, natural resources, consumer and health markets, with business assurance and digital trust services. More than 2,500 laboratories and business facilities in 115 countries.

bvi.name: Bureau Veritas SA
bvi.description: Testing, inspection and certification group with a large buildings and infrastructure business and a marine classification society. Reports four divisions from 1 July 2026 and is exiting Oil & Petrochemicals, coal testing and Government Services.

itrk.name: Intertek Group plc
itrk.description: Assurance, testing, inspection and certification group with five divisions: Consumer Products, Corporate Assurance, Health and Safety, Industry and Infrastructure, and World of Energy.

status.label: Agreed takeover
status.text: EQT (through Isotope Bidco) is acquiring Intertek for £60.00 a share in cash; shareholders also kept the 107.7p final dividend for 2025. Shareholders approved the scheme on 6 August 2026 with 98.72% in favour. Completion is expected in Q4 2026 or Q1 2027, subject to remaining regulatory approvals, after which the shares are due to be delisted.

erf.name: Eurofins Scientific SE
erf.description: Laboratory testing group: food, environment, pharmaceutical and clinical testing through more than 950 laboratories in 59 countries. Sold its electrical and electronics testing business to UL Solutions on 1 October 2026.

alq.name: ALS Limited
alq.description: Laboratory testing group with two divisions: Commodities, led by minerals geochemistry, and Life Sciences, covering environmental, food and pharmaceutical testing. The fiscal year ends on 31 March, so FY26 is the year to 31 March 2026.

tic.name: TIC Solutions, Inc.
tic.hq: Houston, Texas, United States (previously Hollywood, Florida)
tic.description: Asset integrity, engineering and geospatial services, mainly in North America. Formed when Acuren merged with NV5 Global on 4 August 2025; the company took the TIC Solutions name on 10 October 2025. Three segments: Inspection & Mitigation, Consulting & Engineering, and Geospatial.
